ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: advantage_gap_rank_weighted_hinge_loss
ir.intuition: Shift paradigm from margin-based probabilistic loss to a hinge loss based on rank differences, weighting pairs by a soft rank gap to emphasize pairs with larger ranking disagreements. Uses linear hinge penalty instead of logsigmoid and aggregates by weighted mean. This enforces a margin in score differences proportional to rank gap, encouraging clearer ordering with explicit margin constraints.
ir.pseudocode:
rank_gap = ops.maximum(delta_rank, 1.0)
margin_term = margin * rank_gap
score_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
hinge_loss = ops.relu(margin_term - score_diff)
weighted_loss = hinge_loss * weight
final_loss = ops.mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
    margin = float(extra.get('margin', 1.0))
    rank_gap = ops.maximum(delta_rank, 1.0)
    margin_term = ops.mul(margin, rank_gap)
    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    hinge_loss = ops.relu(ops.sub(margin_term, score_diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(hinge_loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
